candidates.reason: Workable left-to-right banner with a dominant headline and a clear CTA. Flaws: the can is jammed against the left edge; the CTA nearly touches the right edge; the legal line is microscopic and illegible; the sticker is shrunk to a thumbnail that crowds the legal text under the headline; the logo is tiny and floats above the headline.

Looks identical to candidate 1, with the same flaws: the can is pinned to the left edge, the CTA hugs the right edge, the legal text is unreadable, the sticker is a cramped thumbnail beside the legal line, and the logo is undersized. Ranked just below candidate 1 only because the ranking cannot tie.

The headline runs flush against the right canvas edge, so it looks clipped. The big sticker placeholder sits in the middle as a competing focal point, and the logo, can and sticker are scattered with uneven gaps. The headline at the far right shrinks its prominence, and the text column's weight is lopsided against the dead centre.

A shrunk copy of the square layout, not a rearrangement. The headline, CTA, logo and can are tiny in a narrow centre column with huge empty sides. The logo wordmark, the can label and the legal text are illegible, so it does not fit the banner format at all.
